title: Refi client pushes for a payment number and gets two
scenario: Greg a landlord with a few rentals, wants to refinance his primary home and keeps asking for an exact rate and payment. The rep quotes both, and later disparages the client's bank.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hey Greg, it's Melissa with Copperleaf Home Loans. You'd asked about refinancing your primary home?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah. Look, I've done this a bunch of times, I own a few rentals. I don't need the whole song and dance.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, fair enough, I'll skip the song and dance. What's the main goal on this one?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Lower payment. Simple. I owe about two-sixty on it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Got it. And roughly what's the house worth?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Around four-fifty. Bought it in twenty-nineteen.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great equity. How are the rentals doing, by the way?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Fine. One tenant just put a hot tub on the deck without asking, so that's fun.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Oh no. That's a new one.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah. Anyway, just give me a number. What rate can you do?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: For you, with that equity, I can do five point eight seven five.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: And what's that make my payment, principal and interest?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: On two-sixty over thirty years, you'd be right around fifteen-forty a month.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hm. My bank said they'd match whatever anyone offers. I'll probably just run it through them.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Honestly, banks say that and then hit you with junk fees at closing. They're not on your side.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I've used them for my last two refis and they were fine.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay, well, at least let me send you something to compare.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Send it. I'll look at it when I look at it.
